title: The Woman with the Issue of Blood: Faith, Uncleanness, and Access to Jesus
description: A narrative exegesis of Mark 5:25-34: Levitical background, the Markan sandwich structure, and what the touch, power, and healing vocabulary reveal about faith crossing social boundaries

title: "I Will Not Drink Again": The Last Supper and the Cups of Passover
description: What the Passover Seder's cup structure reveals about Jesus's vow at the Last Supper not to drink of the fruit of the vine again until the kingdom comes
